# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# The web radio app: stations from stations.txt (or the built-in list), streams played by player.

import time

import lvgl as lv

import player

try:
    import mpy_wifi  # on a Linux board; the network comes from settings.json (the Settings app)
except ImportError:
    mpy_wifi = None

ACCENT = lv.color_hex(0xE0742F)
ROW = lv.color_hex(0x1E2633)
# Name and MP3 stream address. Your own list goes in stations.txt next to main.py (on a Linux board
# /usr/local/mpy/fs/stations.txt), one station per line: Name|http://address
STATIONS = [
    ("Radio Paradise", "http://stream.radioparadise.com/mp3-128"),
    ("Radio Swiss Jazz", "https://stream.srg-ssr.ch/m/rsj/mp3_128"),
    ("FIP", "http://icecast.radiofrance.fr/fip-midfi.mp3"),
]
STATIONS_FILE = "stations.txt"

_ui = None
_player = player.Player(live=True)
_stations = []
_rows = []
_shown = None
_network_job = None
_online = True
_checked = 0


def _clock(seconds):
    seconds = int(seconds)
    return "%d:%02d:%02d" % (seconds // 3600, seconds // 60 % 60, seconds % 60)


def _row_font():
    # List rows follow the screen: bigger letters on an 800x480 screen than on a 480x272 one.
    height = lv.display_get_default().get_vertical_resolution()
    return lv.font_montserrat_24 if height >= 400 else lv.font_montserrat_14


def _caption(button, text):
    button.get_child(0).set_text(text)


def load_stations():
    try:
        with open(STATIONS_FILE) as source:
            found = []
            for line in source:
                name, _, url = line.strip().partition("|")
                if name and url.startswith(("http://", "https://")):
                    found.append((name.strip(), url.strip()))
            if found:
                return found
    except OSError:
        pass
    return STATIONS


def start(ui):
    global _ui, _stations, _network_job
    _ui = ui
    if mpy_wifi is not None:
        try:
            _network_job = mpy_wifi.ensure()  # connects to the Wi-Fi of settings.json if needed
        except (OSError, ValueError) as error:
            print("radio: Wi-Fi:", error)
    lv.screen_active().set_style_bg_color(lv.color_hex(0x121820), 0)
    _caption(ui.prev_button, lv.SYMBOL.PREV)
    _caption(ui.next_button, lv.SYMBOL.NEXT)
    _caption(ui.play_button, lv.SYMBOL.PLAY)
    _caption(ui.volume_down, lv.SYMBOL.VOLUME_MID)
    _caption(ui.volume_up, lv.SYMBOL.VOLUME_MAX)
    ui.station_list.set_style_border_width(0, 0)
    ui.station_list.set_style_radius(10, 0)
    ui.station_list.set_style_pad_all(4, 0)
    ui.station_list.set_style_pad_row(4, 0)
    _stations = load_stations()
    ui.station_list.clean()
    _rows.clear()
    for index, (name, _url) in enumerate(_stations):
        row = lv.button(ui.station_list)
        row.set_width(lv.pct(100))
        row.set_style_bg_color(ROW, 0)
        row.set_style_shadow_width(0, 0)
        label = lv.label(row)
        label.set_text(lv.SYMBOL.AUDIO + "  " + name)
        label.set_style_text_font(_row_font(), 0)
        label.set_long_mode(lv.label.LONG_MODE.DOTS)
        label.set_width(lv.pct(100))
        row.add_event_cb(lambda e, i=index: tune(i), lv.EVENT.CLICKED, None)
        _rows.append(row)
    show()


def tune(index):
    _player.play([url for _name, url in _stations], index)
    show()


def toggle():
    # A live stream is stopped, not paused: play starts it again from now.
    if _player.playing:
        _player.stop()
    elif _stations:
        tune(max(_player.index, 0))
    show()


def next_station():
    _player.next()
    show()


def previous_station():
    if _player.uris:
        tune((_player.index - 1) % len(_player.uris))


def volume_up():
    _player.volume_up()
    show()


def volume_down():
    _player.volume_down()
    show()


def tick():
    global _network_job, _online, _checked
    if _network_job is not None and _network_job.poll() is not None:
        _network_job = None
    if mpy_wifi is not None and time.ticks_diff(time.ticks_ms(), _checked) >= 2000:
        _checked = time.ticks_ms()
        _online = mpy_wifi.online()
    _player.update()
    show()


def show():
    global _shown
    if _ui is None:
        return
    p = _player
    if p.index != _shown and 0 <= p.index < len(_stations):
        _shown = p.index
        _ui.station.set_text(_stations[p.index][0])
        for index, row in enumerate(_rows):
            row.set_style_bg_color(ACCENT if index == p.index else ROW, 0)
        _rows[p.index].scroll_to_view(True)
    _caption(_ui.play_button, lv.SYMBOL.STOP if p.playing else lv.SYMBOL.PLAY)
    if not _online and not p.playing:
        _ui.status.set_text("No internet: connecting..." if _network_job else "No internet: set up Wi-Fi in Settings")
    elif p.error:
        _ui.status.set_text(p.error)
    elif p.playing and p.position > 0:
        _ui.status.set_text("On air  " + _clock(p.position))
    elif p.playing:
        _ui.status.set_text("Connecting...")
    elif p.index >= 0:
        _ui.status.set_text("Stopped")
    _ui.volume.set_text("Volume %d%%" % p.volume)
